title: A governed Streamlit dashboard on ClickHouse with pandas export
outcome: Build a Streamlit dashboard on ClickHouse that reads only typed hypequery datasets: filters, a time series, breakdowns and a pandas CSV export.

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD
env.description: ClickHouse password (default: hypequery, the seed's password)

env.name: CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE
env.description: Database holding the seed tables (default hypequery_examples)

exampleRequest: uv run python -c "from datetime import date; from analytics import queries as q; print(q.kpis(q.Filters(date(2026, 10, 1), date(2026, 10, 31))))"
